name: Ship Spotter
description:
You have spent a lot of time around ships in port and you know just about everything there is to know about them.

You can always identify a watercraft's quality, general purpose, culture of origin and approximate capacity. Any unusual signs of wear or damage stand out to you, and your Lore and Riddle rolls to discern additional information about watercraft are favored.

Describe what you notice about the vessel.
